faq1: Can you help me choose seats?
faq1Answer: Of course. Tell us what matters: being close to the stage, seeing the whole pitch, sitting with your group or staying within budget. Your manager will compare available options and explain the differences.
faq2Answer: Yes. Check the seating map or select “Seats together” in your request and tell us how many tickets you need. We will check available options and confirm the seating arrangement before you confirm your order.
faq3: How and when will I receive my tickets?
faq3Answer: Tickets are sent as files to the email address in your order. Delivery timing is agreed during checkout, and you can check the delivery status in your account. Let your manager know if the event is coming up soon.

faq4: What if my event is not listed?
faq4Answer: Send a request with the event name, city, date and number of tickets. You can also include your budget and seating preferences. We will look into the options and contact you to discuss an offer.
faq5: How are my order and payment confirmed?
faq5Answer: After you place an order, your manager will contact you to confirm the tickets, total price, delivery time and payment arrangements. Please check your contact details so we can reach you.
faq6: Who should I contact about a rescheduled event or a ticket issue?
faq6Answer: Contact your manager or open a support request from your order page. We will check the event information and help you with the next steps. Refund availability depends on the ticket terms and the reason for your request.

aboutTitle:
Helping you find an event.
And the right seats for it.
aboutLead: Tickethub helps you find and buy tickets for sport, concerts and other events. We explain the seats, the offer and when your tickets will arrive.
aboutStory: We start with what matters to you: the view, proximity to the stage, seats together or your budget. Then we compare available options and explain the differences. The choice stays yours.
aboutTeamTitle: A team you can talk to
aboutTeamText: Not sure which section to choose or where to sit with a child? Ask us. We’ll discuss your preferences, explain the seating and suggest options. After booking, we stay in touch about your order.
